title: Thunder vs. Trail Blazers: Live updates, highlights for Tuesday's game
text:
Thunder vs. Trail Blazers: Live updates, highlights for Tuesday's game Rumors Stats Odds Betting Newsletter OKC THUNDER Thunder vs. Trail Blazers: Live updates, highlights for Tuesday's game
 Clemente Almanza OKC Thunder Wire Updated Nov. 10, 2026, 11:17 p.m. CT The Oklahoma City Thunder travel on the road to face the Portland Trail Blazers on Tuesday. This will be the first matchup between the two squads of the 2026-27 regular season. This is also the first night of a road back-to-back for both teams.
 The Thunder (8-2) have snowballed momentum. They enjoyed a 114-75 win over the Washington Wizards on Saturday. Shai Gilgeous-Alexander cruised to 30 points and nine assists in three quarters of the blowout contest.
 Meanwhile, the Trail Blazers (6-3) are hoping to bounce back. They were on the wrong side of a 125-103 loss to the San Antonio Spurs on Saturday. Deni Avdija was limited to 15 points and four rebounds.
 For live updates of the Thunder's game against the Trail Blazers, please regularly check back to this post:
 Half: Thunder 59, Trail Blazers 59
 Gilgeous-Alexander is doing his best to carry the Thunder to a win. He has 20 points already. Nobody on the Trail Blazers can stop falling for his fakes. That said, the other OKC role players have stepped up, too. Mitchell, McCain and Mara come to mind. Meanwhile, Lillard and Avdija are among Portland's best players. Both are getting to the free-throw line pretty easily. Good spot to be at if you're OKC and on the road.
 Love crosswords? Explore the Crossword page and play the new MidGrid Crossword. End 1Q: Thunder 27, Trail Blazers 26
 Gilgeous-Alexander started to hunt for his shot. He likely read the room that everybody else was a little shy to start. He has 12 points and is 6-of-6 on free throws. Portland's aggressive defenders are paying the bill right now. All things considered, good start for OKC on the road.
 1Q, 6:49 left: Trail Blazers 12, Thunder 7
 Avdija barrels his way to the rim. Draws another foul on a drive. Trail Blazers call a timeout. Offense has looked bad for the Thunder.
 Starting lineups:
 The Thunder will start Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, Jared McCain, Ajay Mitchell, Kenrich Williams and Isaiah Hartenstein. The Trail Blazers will start Damian Lillard, Sidy Cissoko, Deni Avdija, Toumani Camara and Donovan Clingan.
 What channel is Thunder vs. Trail Blazers game on today? Time, TV schedule
 TV Channel: NBC, Peacock, Thunder+, KSBI
 Start time: 10 p.m. CT

 Thunder: Jalen Williams (ankle surgery) is out. Cason Wallace (shoulder surgery) is out. Chet Holmgren (knee injury recovery) is out. Jaylin Williams (back spasms) is out. Nikola Topic (G League assignment) is out. Thomas Sorber (knee surgery) is out.
 Trail Blazers: Ja Morant (hamstring strain) is out. Shaedon Sharpe (torn meniscus) is out. Vit Krejci (ankle fracture) is out. John Tonje (G League two-way) is out.
